svg.title: AI instructions and models — what guides the answer
svg.desc: Follow the numbered connectors. Subnumbers identify branches or smaller steps. Optional actions and supporting relationships are labeled separately. The app combines the current question and recent context with server instructions and relevant table details or all loaded result rows. Real mode uses Gemini or OpenAI with server-held credentials. Development mock mode substitutes fixed model output while database queries remain live. The output is SQL or a result explanation.
